text: 中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅3日应约同菲律宾外交部长拉扎罗通电话。 王毅表示，当前中菲关系面临恶意干扰，菲少数政客出于政治偏见和一己私利，一再攻击抹黑中国，踩踏中方红线，将正常的经贸人文交流政治化，侵害中国在菲人员和机构的正当权益。这种恶行丧失理智，不可容忍，也损害菲的国际形象。菲方应加强对有关人员的约束，在对华政策上发出理性、统一的声音。中方维护主权和领土完整、实现国家统一的意志坚定不移。菲方应将一个中国政策落到实处，在涉海问题上谨言慎行。
text_en: On the 3rd, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, took a phone call from Philippine Foreign Secretary Lazaro. Wang Yi said China-Philippines relations currently face malicious disruption; a handful of Philippine politicians, out of political bias and personal gain, have repeatedly attacked and smeared China, crossed China's red lines, politicized normal economic, trade and cultural exchanges, and infringed on the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese personnel and institutions in the Philippines. Such behavior is senseless and intolerable and damages the Philippines' international image. The Philippine side should tighten constraints on relevant personnel and speak with a rational and unified voice on China policy. China's will to safeguard sovereignty and territorial integrity and achieve national reunification is unwavering. The Philippines should implement the one-China policy and act and speak prudently on maritime issues.
